campaign: MathReader v347 cross-disciplinary supplementary 50-file regression round 4
authoritative_source: mathreader(7).zip + previous documentation-only root patches; original JS source unchanged
distinctness: 50 SHA-256 distinct PDFs, excluding the previous 100-file + 6-file campaign hashes (106). Related editions and content reuse present; no claim of 50 independent publications.
execution: Every document: native lines/pages via PyMuPDF and v347 buildStructureIndex/buildEquationLabelIndex in Node VM with mocked browser state. OCR proxy on 311 selected <30 native-character pages, Tesseract 160dpi PSM3 eng or chi_sim+eng, OpenMP threads=1. No production browser PDF.js/Texify/WebGPU or posterior equation image-assist.
interpretation: All detector label counts are source-level proxy counts, not ground-truth accuracy or whole-document verification. The 1285 unattempted OCR pages remain UNVERIFIED.
limitations: 50 PDFs are mostly already-available user Library documents; several related lecture-note cumulative editions and Chinese math research revisions; limited independent archival cross-field coverage.
Native PDF text extraction and line grouping use PyMuPDF, first 29 PDFs via span dict and last 21 via word geometry, unlike browser PDF.js.
OCR is not full coverage: 311/1596 candidate pages were processed. Of those, 18 successfully executed OCR calls yielded zero text.
Structure bookmarks only checked as PDF embedded outline metadata counts, not browser Structure UI or inferred outline correctness.
No independent complete page-level ground truth; no browser OCR fallback/performance, no visual per-item review of all 8823 pages; no 100% verified file.
New external archival NASA/USGS candidates were found online but original PDF bytes could not be fetched into detector runtime, so were not included.

method_variants.native: PDF page line geometry PyMuPDF blocks, span dict for first 29 documents, word group for remaining 21
method_variants.ocr: Tesseract 5, 160 DPI, PSM3, OMP_THREAD_LIMIT=1, English or Simplified Chinese+English, sampled high-priority scan/handwriting whole docs and sparse long books
method_variants.mathreader: Actual v347 41-equations-bibliography.js source-level buildStructureIndex and buildEquationLabelIndex; stubbed browser UI/state, image-assist intentionally disabled

confirmed_issues.evidence: The source page is headed SUBJECT INDEX; Definition is a subject-index headword with lexical subentries and page references, not a mathematical Definition. Visually checked source scan.
confirmed_issues.root_cause_hypothesis: Unnumbered mathematical-result type recognition is not sufficiently gated against back-of-book subject-index entries, particularly when the word Definition stands alone.
confirmed_issues.severity: moderate, false mathematical Results entry in nonmath research and reference books
confirmed_issues.deferral: Conservative negative evidence across other dictionaries and positive test of genuine unnumbered mathematical Definitions required; no filename-specific fix or broad index-page suppression.
confirmed_issues.verification_scope: Local PyMuPDF geometry + actual source detector in Node VM, manually inspected original PDF page image; no production browser

manual_spot_checks.visible: SUBJECT INDEX; Definition and multiple headword subentries
